Page.title: About Me
Page._content:
## Profile

My name is **Haoyu Chen**. I am currently an undergraduate student majoring in Physics at Tsinghua University. I am broadly interested in condensed matter theory and quantum physics, with a particular fascination for the emergent phenomena that arise when many quantum degrees of freedom interact with each other. I enjoy approaching physical problems from both analytical and computational perspectives, and I use this blog to document my learning notes, derivations, and research reflections.

## Research Interests

- **Non-equilibrium phenomena in many-body systems** — thermalization, many-body localization, and the dynamics of isolated quantum systems.
- **Quantum tunneling in transition-metal dichalcogenides (TMDCs)** — especially light-driven tunneling, and their implications for nanoscale devices.
- **Strongly correlated physics** — emergent orders and phase transitions in interacting quantum matter.

## Education

| Period | Institution | Program |
|--------|-------------|---------|
| 2025 – 2026 | Tsinghua University | B.S. in Physics |

## Contact

- **Email:** your@email.com
- **GitHub:** [@C1-H-Y](https://github.com/C1-H-Y)

前言

这是一篇测试 LaTeX 公式的博客。

行内公式

质能方程 E = mc2 是爱因斯坦提出的。

块级公式

高斯积分：

$$ \int_{-\infty}^{\infty} e^{-x^2} dx = \sqrt{\pi} $$

矩阵

$$ A = \begin{bmatrix} 1 & 2 & 3 \\ 4 & 5 & 6 \\ 7 & 8 & 9 \end{bmatrix} $$

多行推导

$$ \begin{aligned} (a+b)^2 &= (a+b)(a+b) \\ &= a^2 + ab + ba + b^2 \\ &= a^2 + 2ab + b^2 \end{aligned} $$

Mermaid 图表（可选）

Butterfly 也支持 Mermaid，在 _config.butterfly.yml 里开 mermaid.enable: true 后可以这样用csdn.net：

Post.title: Hello World
Post._content:
Welcome to [Hexo](https://hexo.io/)! This is your very first post. Check [documentation](https://hexo.io/docs/) for more info. If you get any problems when using Hexo, you can find the answer in [troubleshooting](https://hexo.io/docs/troubleshooting.html) or you can ask me on [GitHub](https://github.com/hexojs/hexo/issues).

## Quick Start

### Create a new post

``` bash
$ hexo new "My New Post"
```

More info: [Writing](https://hexo.io/docs/writing.html)

### Run server

``` bash
$ hexo server
```

More info: [Server](https://hexo.io/docs/server.html)

### Generate static files

``` bash
$ hexo generate
```

More info: [Generating](https://hexo.io/docs/generating.html)

### Deploy to remote sites

``` bash
$ hexo deploy
```

More info: [Deployment](https://hexo.io/docs/one-command-deployment.html)
